_about: Luna's LLM benchmark questions (see README → Development → LLM benchmark). kind: chat | fact | math | search | opinion | wake | date. expect: regexes (case-insensitive), any one must match the answer — tried against the answer as spoken and with number words turned into digits. "$weekday" stands for today's weekday. search: required | forbidden (left out = the model decides). personality: rated by bench/rate.js.
